notes: The paper uses N for the number of clauses (Sec. IV-A), not for TA states. a = active-literal list size, t = lower TA-state threshold below which a literal is dropped, p = max clause size (stored as max_included_literals). T and s are named as parameters but never given. Table I 'Best' is 'the best reproducible accuracy' - not said whether over epochs or runs; number of runs, seeds and Table I epoch count are not stated. Figs. 5, 6 and 8 (per-epoch time/accuracy on SUBJ) are figure-only and not digitized. For CR, MPQA, SST-2, MR and PC the paper never says bag-of-words explicitly (only 'bit-encoded'; the introduction speaks of bag-of-word-based NLP representations), so their booleanization method is not_reported although the record says 'bag-of-words bit encoding'. Amazon train/test counts are exactly 80/20 of each random subset, but how the subset is split is not stated. Contracting TM in Fig. 7 also used absorbing state 50 and literal sampling 0.6 (no schema field). Record values checked against Tables I-II and Sec. IV-C text: no disagreements found.
